property_summary: For any addresses currentOwner and newOwner where currentOwner is the contract owner, when currentOwner calls transferOwnership(newOwner) the contract's owner becomes newOwner; the mutant instead sets owner to msg.sender, so when msg.sender != newOwner the mutant violates this rule.
change_summary: Invert the assignment to set owner to the caller instead of the provided newOwner, so owner becomes msg.sender.
